sources.finding: Legacy link redirects to Connect Sync operations. Staging imports/synchronizes but does not normally export or run password sync/writeback; switching is an explicit active-passive procedure, never automatic active-active failover. Keep configuration aligned, verify pending exports/deletion protection and isolate the old active server before promotion. Password catch-up can take hours; do not restart during catch-up. This is not Cloud Sync equivalence or evidence of tested recovery.
